title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 35
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 35: the word against Mount Seir, which rejoiced when the house of Israel lay desolate.

questions.text: Against what is the son of man told to set his face and prophesy?
questions.explanation: Yahweh tells the son of man to set his face against Mount Seir and to prophesy against it.

questions.text: What does the Lord Yahweh say he will stretch out against Mount Seir?
questions.explanation: The Lord Yahweh says that he is against Mount Seir and will stretch out his hand against it.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say will happen to the cities of Mount Seir?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will lay its cities waste, and it will be desolate.

answers.text: They will be given to Israel

questions.text: What had Mount Seir done to the children of Israel in the time of their calamity?
questions.explanation: Mount Seir had a perpetual hostility and gave the children of Israel over to the power of the sword in the time of their calamity.

answers.text: Given them over to the sword

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will prepare Mount Seir for?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will prepare Mount Seir for blood, and blood will pursue it, since it has not hated blood.

questions.text: With what will Yahweh fill the mountains of Mount Seir?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will fill its mountains with its slain, who will fall in its hills, valleys and watercourses.

questions.text: What had Mount Seir said about the two nations and the two countries?
questions.explanation: Mount Seir said that these two nations and these two countries would be its own and that they would possess them, whereas Yahweh was there.

answers.text: That they should be left empty
That they would be its own possession

questions.text: According to what does Yahweh say he will act against Mount Seir?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will do according to Mount Seir's anger and according to its envy, which it showed out of its hatred.

answers.text: According to the word of the prophets
According to the treaties of the nations
According to its own anger and envy
According to the number of its cities

questions.text: What insults had Yahweh heard spoken against the mountains of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh had heard them say of the mountains of Israel that they had been laid desolate and had been given to them to devour.

answers.text: That they were too strong to attack
That they were laid desolate and given to them to devour
That Yahweh had blessed them richly
That they would soon be restored

questions.text: Over what had Mount Seir rejoiced, so that Yahweh will do the same to it?
questions.explanation: Because Mount Seir rejoiced over the inheritance of the house of Israel when it was desolate, Yahweh will make Mount Seir and all Edom desolate.

answers.text: Over the harvest of its own hills
Over the fall of the land of Egypt
Over a victory won at sea
Over the inheritance of the house of Israel
